title: Surgical Humanoids & Starlink Dog Tracking
tagline: Tech, science, and what's actually interesting

stories.title: In vivo feasibility study of humanoid robots in surgery
stories.summary: Nature, Published online: 08 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10796-xA systematic evaluation shows that contemporary humanoid robots can perform laparoscopic surgical tasks through teleoperation, highlighting both their promise and key technical challenges before clinical deployment.

stories.title: Fi expands Starlink direct-to-device capability into dog-tracking
stories.summary: Pet technology company Fi launched a dog tracker July 8 that uses T-Mobile’s Starlink-enabled T-Satellite service to remain connected across the United States, even outside the telco’s terrestrial network. The post Fi expands Starlink direct-to-device capability into dog-tracking appeared first on SpaceNews.

stories.title: Separating signal from noise in coding evaluations
stories.summary: A new analysis from OpenAI reveals issues in SWE-Bench Pro, a popular coding benchmark, raising concerns about reliability and accuracy in evaluating AI models.

stories.title: Small Steps, Giant Leaps Podcast Episode 177: Transformative Aeronautics
stories.summary: A NASA research program collaborates with universities to revolutionize the way we design, build, and operate aircraft. stories.title: Observation of Floquet rotational super-radiance
stories.summary: Nature, Published online: 08 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10725-yA Floquet regime of rotational super-radiance has been observed in a spatiotemporally modulated ring network of resonators.

stories.title: Flint: A visualization language for the AI era
stories.summary: Short chart specifications are easy to write, but often produce uninspiring results. Flint is an open-source visualization language that offers a middle path, letting AI agents create expressive charts from compact, human-editable specifications. The post Flint: A visualization language for the AI era appeared first on Microsoft Research.
